en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4549 - Aban ibn Uthman narrated that a man named Ibn Ziyad al-Ta'i said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (as): "I was a slave and got married without the permission of my masters. Then Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, granted me freedom. Should I renew the marriage contract?"
Imam (as) said: "Were they aware that you had married?"
I said: "Yes, they knew and remained silent without objecting."
Imam (as) said: "Their silence is considered approval. You remain upon your original marriage contract."
